name: Workbook tracker
summary: One series from a workbook you open, with the change since the last read.
description: Workbook tracker opens a workbook you choose, then the columns you confirm. It shows the current total, how that total moved, and an optional pace against a plan you set. It does not assume a path, a column name, or a target. It writes nothing, uses no network, and does not call a model on its own.
highlights: You open the workbook. The card does not guess a folder.
You pick the columns, or confirm a suggestion.
An optional pace compares spend per day with the plan per day.
